subject: Picnic plan
text: I checked the park calendar. The picnic is still open. We can meet on Sunday. Ten people have said yes. Mia wants a board game. I think music is better. Mia has a fair point. A game could be slow. People might not join in. Music keeps things moving. I can bring a small speaker. The volume will stay low. That was my worry too. Neighbors complained last time. This time we will be careful. I asked the park office. They gave a simple rule. Keep it under half volume. That is fair enough. I can bring games too. You can bring the speaker. We can decide after lunch. If Mia prefers cards, we will play cards. If others prefer dancing, we will dance. It is a small problem. We can still make it fun. At work I answer tickets. Here I want a picnic. I sent a group note. Please check the reply soon. I booked a cafe table. That gives us a backup plan. If rain comes, we can sit inside. I packed extra napkins. You always forget those. No hard feelings. I know you meant well. Just send the list tonight. I will buy the lemonade. I also added two umbrellas. Do not forget them. The forecast is uncertain. We can share snacks later. Bring the folding chairs. Please bring the blue ones. They sit lower. Also bring the sunscreen. I bought fruit cups. I hope that is enough. Please. Reply soon. See you at the entrance.
